scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the absolute difference between the agent's reported barrier/frequency and the paper's published values. Full DFT recomputation from raw quantum outputs is infeasible in the verifier; this result-level comparison with tolerances is the strongest feasible check.

outputs.description: The computed forward barrier heights (ΔE, in kcal/mol) and imaginary vibrational frequencies (magnitude, in cm⁻¹) for the four isomer interconversions.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each barrier and frequency to gold reference values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for barrier heights (kcal/mol) and imaginary frequencies (cm⁻¹) for each interconversion, extracted from Table 2 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2: Li2B12H12 isomer interconversion TS results. DOI: 10.1016/j.cplett.2010.08.018
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published values, repeated by the reference solve.sh; the checker scores the agent's reproduction against them.
